name: web-trgovina
description: Web trgovina odjeće — Express + MongoDB API, React klijent i React admin panel

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,client,admin -c cyan,magenta,yellow "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client" "npm run dev -w admin"
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client && npm run build -w admin
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client && npm run typecheck -w admin
